title: Pale Receipt Runner
text: Pale Receipt Runner slips between travelers stamping possessions as seized before anyone notices the mark. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Ownership changes with a tap of wet ink.

defeatReward.text: Pale Receipt Runner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
